authored_assumptions: This is an original detailed interpretation of the existing lamp, not a scanned or recovered industrial product.
The eight named joints and their rest coordinates are preserved; all hidden hardware, cord routing and shade interior are authored.
The open shade includes separate outer and interior wall surfaces, aperture trim, rear cap and bulb; the warm diffuser is geometry, not an emitted simulated light.
Arms, hinge caps, springs and cord sections use explicit rigid or blended skin weights; no mechanical spring, cable or electrical simulation is claimed.
The pad retains a fixed circular guide; the stylus traces gestures without dynamically creating ink.
Opaque PBR metal/roughness and embedded procedural brushed textures target the browser, not Weft's restricted diffuse-only profile.
The four skeletal actions are authored local animations and do not duplicate a simulator or change Weft actions or rewards.

HD textures are seeded, locally authored procedural patterns at native1024/2048 resolution, not neural output, reference-extracted texture maps or evidence of photorealism. Studio floor and exposure are render settings, not simulation geometry.

hd_upgrade.edit_prompt: Preserve this character/object's exact base mesh components, proportions, palettes, accessories, bone rests and four skeletal actions. Add native-resolution 1024/2048 procedural basecolor and tangent-normal textures with irregular fine surface detail, not an enlarged 512px bitmap. Use a grounded soft studio with world strength0.3 and exposure0.55. Do not claim exact Muse reconstruction or equal visual quality before rendering and comparison. Keep all sources and all prior recipes unchanged. Use two bounded HD brushed-metal finishes only; retain enamel, rubber, glass-like and paper material identities. Do not add animal fur.
hd_upgrade.exact_user_request: you're working on making these avatars better right? I want the same textures and hd quality as the muse ones for example fura and hari
hd_upgrade.prior_source_prompt: Create a complete editable desk-lamp robot, distinct from a creature or humanoid. Use a stable burgundy circular base, twin-bar lower and upper arms, brass hinge caps, a tapered brass shade and an opaque warm-colored bulb. Keep the base, arm lengths and shade proportions consistent in all states. Idle is a small curious look-around; making_something is a precise repeated shade-tip tracing gesture over its work pad; working is a slow wide inspection scan; milestone_level_up is a proud upright stretch and double head nod. Author hidden mechanical surfaces, pivots and rigid skin weights explicitly. Do not claim real light emission, dynamic ink, physical dynamics or reference reconstruction. Revision: preserve the burgundy/brass lamp identity, silhouette and fixed camera. Add a slim base-supported rotary tracing arm and vertically sliding stylus over the cream work pad. The visible stylus must follow the existing circular guide in making_something, then remain visibly lifted and stowed in idle, working and milestone_level_up. The guide is pre-existing geometry, not newly generated ink. Keep the mechanism legible and subordinate to the lamp.

glb.skeletal_clips: All four original clips preserved unchanged

hd_upgrade.source_prompt: Refine the original burgundy-and-brass animated workshop lamp as a complete high-quality designer object. Preserve its articulated two-link arm, expressive two-eye base display, eight named joints, four actions, sketch pad and independently animated circular tracing stylus. Replace the solid cone with an open, curved bell shade with an interior reflector, rim and real bulb. Model beveled enamel base tiers, layered metal hinge disks, axle caps with screw slots, paired arm rails, small springs and power-cord sections that stay attached during existing motion. Distinguish brushed brass, glossy burgundy enamel, dark rubber, glassy warm diffuser and paper through opaque PBR materials. Preserve every visible feature in the GLB with actual skin weights; no render-only props or light simulation. Complete the back and underside rather than relying on one camera angle.

studio_grounding.method: Conservative authored rest bounds of named contact parts, including configured maximum fur length; not simulated ground contact

states.meaning: A small inquisitive look-around: base swivel and two opposing shade tilts.
Lowers the visible stylus onto its fixed circular guide and traces two back-and-forth arcs while the shade aims at the pad. No new marks are generated.
Stretches into a proud upright pose and gives two delighted shade nods before folding back.
Leans toward the work pad and makes a broad slow inspection sweep, unlike the short repetitive tracing state.
